تستدعون (form X)
# تَسْتَدْعُونَ (tastadʕūna) /tas.tad.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَدْعَى (istadʕā)
# تُسْتَدْعَوْنَ (tustadʕawna) /tus.tad.ʕaw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَدْعَى (istadʕā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
